findings.body: Function `inc-one` is documented to 'Increment the input by exactly one.', but the implementation was changed from `(+ x 1)` to `(+ x 2)`. This causes `(inc-one x)` to return `x + 2`, violating its docstring contract and function name.
failure_trace: Expected return value is 2 based on contract 'Increment the input by exactly one.'
findings.title: Function `inc-one` increments by two instead of one

questions: Was `(+ x 2)` introduced unintentionally during testing or meant for a separate `inc-two` function?
summary: Found 1 defect: `inc-one` in increment.clj was modified to increment by 2 instead of 1, breaking its documented contract.
